title: When the Bridge Falls
author: Isandro Halloran
blurb: Isandro Okafor, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
